question: For Nivolumab, Ipilimumab combination therapy trials, list additional agents in the treatment regimen beyond the ICI.
augmented_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Treatment regimen", "Control regimen" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Name of ICI" = 'Nivolumab, Ipilimumab' AND "Monotherapy/combination" = 'Combination';
